issue_context.title: JsonConverter for {ReadOnly}Memory doesn't deserialize nulls
comments:
Tagging subscribers to this area: @dotnet/area-system-text-json, @gregsdennis See info in [area-owners.md](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/area-owners.md) if you want to be subscribed.
Issue Details
Given that this code runs successfully without exception or assert: ```C# using System.Diagnostics; using System.Text.Json; ReadOnlyMemory rom; rom = default; Debug.Assert(rom.IsEmpty); rom = null; Debug.Assert(rom.IsEmpty); rom = (ReadOnlyMemory)null; Debug.Assert(rom.IsEmpty); rom = ((float[])null!).AsMemory(); Debug.Assert(rom.IsEmpty); rom = JsonSerializer.Deserialize("null"); Debug.Assert(rom.IsEmpty); ``` it breaks my expectations that this: ```C# rom = JsonSerializer.Deserialize>("null"); // boom ``` throws an exception: ``` Unhandled exception. System.Text.Json.JsonException: The JSON value could not be converted to System.ReadOnlyMemory`1[System.Single]. Path: $ | LineNumber: 0 | BytePositionInLine: 4. at System.Text.Json.ThrowHelper.ThrowJsonException_DeserializeUnableToConvertValue(Type propertyType) at System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter`1.TryRead(Utf8JsonReader& reader, Type typeToConvert, JsonSerializerOptions options, ReadStack& state, T& value, Boolean& isPopulatedValue) at System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter`1.ReadCore(Utf8JsonReader& reader, JsonSerializerOptions options, ReadStack& state) at System.Text.Json.Serialization.Metadata.JsonTypeInfo`1.Deserialize(Utf8JsonReader& reader, ReadStack& state) at System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.ReadFromSpan[TValue](ReadOnlySpan`1 utf8Json, JsonTypeInfo`1 jsonTypeInfo, Nullable`1 actualByteCount) at System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.ReadFromSpan[TValue](ReadOnlySpan`1 json, JsonTypeInfo`1 jsonTypeInfo) at System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize[TValue](String json, JsonSerializerOptions options) ```
Author: stephentoub
Assignees: -
Labels: `area-System.Text.Json`
Milestone: -
cc @Jozkee, do you think we should try change this to support `null` JSON tokens?

I believe so, yes. Just FWIW, `readonly struct ImmutableArray<T>` also throws this exception, but I believe `ImmutableArray<T>` doesn't have any bonds with null as opposed to this one. I'm not aware of any more "struct collections" to use as a reference for the semantic.

review_comments: Why do you need to override both?

`HandleNull` controls whether the serialization infrastructure should call this converter on `JsonTokenType.Null` values (by default it does that handling automatically), so we need to override it in order to run the custom logic in the `OnTryRead` method.
This change adds some wiring that was being dropped so far.
I was about to ask :) Does that mean there's another bug that was lurking and this was fixing?
Correct, it was surfaced with the newly added tests.

For context this is a converter wrapper type that is being used by the source generator APIs. The logic I just added was copied from a similar wrapper type being used internally:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/acf7c85d2ab9c598ff71b6baa733a7098f7f6148/src/libraries/System.Text.Json/src/System/Text/Json/Serialization/Converters/CastingConverter.cs#L27-L36
